title: "Traffic_Proximity"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data_path <- paste0(
  "data/raw/",
  "EJScreen_2024_Tract_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.csv/",
  "EJSCREEN_2024_Tract_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.csv"
)

ej <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

dim(ej)
```

```{r}
analysis_data <- ej %>%
  transmute(
    tract_id = ID,
    state = STATE_NAME,
    region = REGION,
    population = ACSTOTPOP,
    people_of_color_pct = PEOPCOLORPCT,
    low_income_pct = LOWINCPCT,
    diesel_pm = DSLPM,
    traffic_proximity = PTRAF,
    land_area_m2 = AREALAND,
    population_density = ACSTOTPOP /
      (AREALAND / 2589988.11)
  )

dim(analysis_data)
```

```{r}
analysis_clean <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    population > 0,
    land_area_m2 > 0,
    !is.na(diesel_pm),
    !is.na(people_of_color_pct),
    !is.na(low_income_pct),
    !is.na(region),
    is.finite(population_density)
  )

nrow(analysis_clean)
```

```{r}
analysis_clean <- analysis_clean %>%
  mutate(
    log_population_density = log1p(population_density),
    log_traffic_proximity = if_else(
      !is.na(traffic_proximity) &
        traffic_proximity >= 0,
      log1p(traffic_proximity),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

summary(analysis_clean$log_traffic_proximity)
```

```{r}
traffic_data <- analysis_clean %>%
  drop_na(
    diesel_pm,
    people_of_color_pct,
    log_traffic_proximity,
    log_population_density,
    low_income_pct,
    region
  )

nrow(traffic_data)
```

## Subquestion 1: Traffic proximity and diesel PM

Question: How is traffic proximity associated with modeled diesel PM across census tracts?

```{r}

traffic_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_tracts = n(),
    mean_diesel_pm = mean(diesel_pm),
    median_diesel_pm = median(diesel_pm),
    mean_traffic = mean(traffic_proximity),
    median_traffic = median(traffic_proximity),
    min_traffic = min(traffic_proximity),
    max_traffic = max(traffic_proximity)
  )
```

```{r}
model_traffic <- lm(
  diesel_pm ~ log_traffic_proximity,
  data = traffic_data
)

summary(model_traffic)
```

```{r}
confint(model_traffic)
```

```{r}
p_traffic <- ggplot(
  traffic_data,
  aes(
    x = log_traffic_proximity,
    y = diesel_pm
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.08,
    size = 0.4,
    color = "steelblue"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    color = "firebrick",
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Traffic Proximity and Modeled Diesel PM",
    x = "Log-transformed traffic proximity",
    y = "Modeled diesel PM",
    caption = "Source: EPA EJScreen 2024 census tract data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_traffic
```

## Subquestion 2: Does traffic account for part of the demographic association?

Question: How much does the association between people-of-color share and diesel PM change after adding traffic proximity?

```{r}
model_demographic <- lm(
  diesel_pm ~ people_of_color_pct,
  data = traffic_data
)

summary(model_demographic)
```

```{r}
model_demographic_traffic <- lm(
  diesel_pm ~
    people_of_color_pct +
    log_traffic_proximity,
  data = traffic_data
)

summary(model_demographic_traffic)
```

```{r}
beta_before <- coef(
  model_demographic
)["people_of_color_pct"]

beta_after <- coef(
  model_demographic_traffic
)["people_of_color_pct"]

reduction_pct <- 100 *
  (beta_before - beta_after) / beta_before

reduction_pct
```

```{r}
confint(
  model_demographic,
  "people_of_color_pct"
) * 0.10

confint(
  model_demographic_traffic,
  "people_of_color_pct"
) * 0.10
```

## Subquestion 3: Fully adjusted traffic analysis

Question: Does traffic proximity remain associated with diesel PM after accounting for other neighborhood characteristics?

```{r}
model_traffic_adjusted <- lm(
  diesel_pm ~
    log_traffic_proximity +
    people_of_color_pct +
    log_population_density +
    low_income_pct +
    factor(region),
  data = traffic_data
)

summary(model_traffic_adjusted)
```

```{r}
confint(model_traffic_adjusted)
```

```{r}
model_comparison <- tibble(
  model = c(
    "Demographic only",
    "Demographic + traffic",
    "Fully adjusted"
  ),
  r_squared = c(
    summary(model_demographic)$r.squared,
    summary(model_demographic_traffic)$r.squared,
    summary(model_traffic_adjusted)$r.squared
  ),
  adjusted_r_squared = c(
    summary(model_demographic)$adj.r.squared,
    summary(model_demographic_traffic)$adj.r.squared,
    summary(model_traffic_adjusted)$adj.r.squared
  )
)

model_comparison
```

```{r}
get_poc_effect <- function(model, name) {
  beta <- coef(model)["people_of_color_pct"]

  ci <- confint(
    model,
    "people_of_color_pct"
  )

  tibble(
    model = name,
    estimate = beta * 0.10,
    lower = ci[1] * 0.10,
    upper = ci[2] * 0.10
  )
}

poc_effects <- bind_rows(
  get_poc_effect(
    model_demographic,
    "Unadjusted"
  ),
  get_poc_effect(
    model_demographic_traffic,
    "Traffic adjusted"
  ),
  get_poc_effect(
    model_traffic_adjusted,
    "Fully adjusted"
  )
)

poc_effects
```

```{r}
p_coefficients <- ggplot(
  poc_effects,
  aes(
    x = estimate,
    y = reorder(model, estimate)
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    color = "steelblue"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper
    ),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Demographic Association Across Regression Models",
    subtitle = "Effect of a 10-percentage-point increase in people-of-color share",
    x = "Change in modeled diesel PM (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: EPA EJScreen 2024 census tract data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_coefficients
```

## Model diagnostics

These help assess whether the linear regression assumptions are reasonable.

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(model_traffic, which = 1)
plot(model_traffic_adjusted, which = 1)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(model_traffic, which = 2)
plot(model_traffic_adjusted, which = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
plot(
  model_traffic_adjusted,
  which = 4
)
```
